answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7321 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamualaikum 1-Regarding playing carrom board in answer 3081 in english you mention its permissible and in answer 6850 in urdu you mention its makrooh tahreemi why does the answers conflict each other? 2-Is it permissible to play carrom board if a person obeys the laws of shariah and sell Carrom board to others? could you please give a answer which is certain. Question: Asalamualaikum 1-Regarding playing carrom board in answer 3081 in english you mention its permissible and in answer 6850 in urdu you mention its makrooh tahreemi why does the answers conflict each other? 2-Is it permissible to play carrom board if a person obeys the laws of shariah and sell Carrom board to others? could you please give a answer which is certain. Answer ID: 7321 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2245/1833=B/1429) There is no contradiction in both the answers. In the answer 3081, playing carom board occasionally for entertainment and discarding boredom has been declared allowable, it is not made allowed without any condition; rather it is allowable only when the conditions mentioned in the fatwa are met. On the other hand, the answer 6850 was given in cases when the conditions are not fulfilled. (2) It is allowable to play with the conditions mentioned in answer 3081 and it is makrooh to sell it to others. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
